_about: Arabic letters in the order of the Bosnian Sufara (and the 'Sufara by Amsal Memic' YouTube playlist, recited by hfz. Nermin Spahić). joins=false: the letter never joins to the NEXT letter. harakat: the letter with fatha, kasra, damma. similar: look-alike letters used in the 'find the letter' game.

letters.name: Alif
letters.tip: Alif has no sound of its own. It carries a long “aa” (as in “father”), or holds a hamza (ء) that says a, i or u.

letters.name: Dal
letters.tip: Like “d” in “dad” – the tip of the tongue touches just behind the upper front teeth.

letters.name: Dhal
letters.tip: Like “th” in “this” – the tip of the tongue peeks out between the teeth.

letters.name: Ra
letters.tip: A rolled “r”, like in Spanish or Bosnian – the tongue taps the roof of the mouth.

letters.name: Zay
letters.tip: Like “z” in “zoo”.

letters.name: Ba
letters.tip: Like “b” in “ball”.

letters.name: Ta
letters.tip: Like “t” in “tap”, but softer – the tongue touches just behind the upper front teeth.

letters.name: Tha
letters.tip: Like “th” in “think” – the tip of the tongue peeks out between the teeth.

letters.name: Nun
letters.tip: Like “n” in “nose”.

letters.name: Waw
letters.tip: Like “w” in “water”. After a damma it makes a long “oo” (as in “moon”).

letters.name: Ya
letters.tip: Like “y” in “yes”. After a kasra it makes a long “ee” (as in “see”).

letters.name: Lam
letters.tip: Like “l” in “lamp”.

letters.name: Fa
letters.tip: Like “f” in “fish”.

letters.name: Qaf
letters.tip: No English sound: a deep “k” made far back in the throat, where you would gargle.

letters.name: Mim
letters.tip: Like “m” in “moon”.

letters.name: Kaf
letters.tip: Like “k” in “kite”.

letters.name: Ha
letters.tip: Like “h” in “hat” – a soft breath from deep in the chest.

letters.name: Haa
letters.tip: No English sound: a strong, breathy “h” from the middle of the throat – like breathing on glasses to clean them.

letters.name: Kha
letters.tip: Like “ch” in the Scottish word “loch” – a soft scraping sound at the top of the throat.

letters.name: Sin
letters.tip: Like “s” in “sun”.

letters.name: Jim
letters.tip: Like “j” in “jam”.

letters.name: Shin
letters.tip: Like “sh” in “ship”.

letters.name: Sad
letters.tip: A heavy, deep “s” – round your lips a little and keep the tongue low. Compare with the light س.

letters.name: Dad
letters.tip: A heavy, deep “d” made with the side of the tongue – a sound found only in Arabic.

letters.name: Taa
letters.tip: A heavy, deep “t” – full mouth, tongue pressed up. Compare with the light ت.

letters.name: Dhaa
letters.tip: A heavy, deep “th” as in “this” – tongue between the teeth, full mouth. Compare with the light ذ.

letters.name: ‘Ayn
letters.tip: No English sound: a squeezed sound from the middle of the throat, like the start of a surprised “ah!”.

letters.name: Ghayn
letters.tip: Like a soft gargle, or the French “r” in “Paris”.
